name: Lodder Up & Camp - Thomas Hill
note: Opened May 2024; no showers (a porta-potty only), and the operator pitches it to Thomas Hill Power Plant crews in the spring and fall outage seasons as well as to campers, hunters and anglers. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator page lodderupandcamp.com/copy-of-marceline (read 2026-11-07): new campground opened May 1, 2024 near the MDC northeast boat launch, 22 full-hookup sites with 120V/30A/50A, $35/night, $200/week, $500/month + electric, online booking via ParkWithUs, free WiFi, no showers (porta potty), dumpster; contact page: Frank (660) 815-1583. ParkWithUs listing: year-round, opened April 2024, 'RV Site' type. OutReserve mirror (cdn.parkwith.us map) lists 19 bookable RV sites (3-6, 9, 13-26), full hookups 30/50 A, $35/night. Price gate: $35 <= $50. Quality gate FAILS: no RV Life or Good Sam listing, Google 5.0 from 2 reviews (< 25).
waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery (Macon County 2024, dated 2024-02-13 - three months before opening; 2.0 km, 600 m and 380 m frames, all rendered, read 2026-11-07): the park parcel is a cleared, graded rectangle on the north side of the gravel road east of the Gazelle St intersection, among farm fields and woods; Thomas Hill Reservoir's shore is ~1.2-1.5 km west (MDC entry 13905's loop at the boat launch is 1.5 km away); only stock ponds well under 5 acres nearby, none at the parcel -> not waterfront. Pads not yet visible in that imagery, so the pin is the parcel centre.
fees_source: lodderupandcamp.com/copy-of-marceline read 2026-11-07: '$35/night', '$200/week', '$500/month + electric'; two adults included, $2/night per extra person 12+; online bookings carry up to a 10% processing fee. OutReserve mirror of the ParkWithUs inventory: every site $35/night. Undated operator page (the park opened 2024, so the rate is 2024 or later); no engine quote read (see flags).
